```
        let aniskip_c = aniskip.clone();
        let client_c = client.clone();
        let title_c = title_c.clone();
        let ep_c = ep_c.clone();
        let progress2 = progress.clone();
        let progress_bars2 = progress_bars.clone();
        let toast2 = toast.clone();
        let media_title2 = media_title.clone();
        let saved_pos2 = saved_pos;
        let prog_key = format!("{tid}:{season}:{episode}");

        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            // socket beklenir
            let start = std::time::Instant::now();
            while alive.get() && !Path::new(&sock_poll).exists() {
                if start.elapsed() > std::time::Duration::from_secs(30) { return; }
                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(250));
            }
            if !alive.get() { return; }

            // ilk açılış bildirimi
            let t = adw::Toast::new(&format!("▶ {media_title2} açılıyor…{}",
                saved_pos2.map(|p| { let s=p as u64; if s>=3600 {format!(" ({}:{:02}:{:02}'den)", s/3600,(s%3600)/60,s%60)} else {format!(" ({}:{:02}'den)", s/60, s%60)} }).unwrap_or_default()));
            t.set_timeout(3);
            toast2.add_toast(t);

            let (sender, receiver) = std::sync::mpsc::channel::<(f64, f64)>();
            let sender = std::sync::Arc::new(sender);
            let sender_c = sender.clone();

            std::thread::spawn(move || {
                let mut current_ep = ep_c.episode;
                let current_season = ep_c.season;
                let mut op_prompted = false;
                let mut ed_prompted = false;
                loop {
                    if Path::new(&sock_c).exists() {
                        if let Ok(cmd_str) = std::fs::read_to_string(&cmd_c) {
                            if !cmd_str.is_empty() {
                                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&cmd_c);
                                let target_ep = if cmd_str.trim() == "next" { current_ep + 1 }
                                    else if cmd_str.trim() == "prev" && current_ep > 1 { current_ep - 1 }
                                    else { current_ep };
                                if target_ep != current_ep {
                                    let target = Episode { episode: target_ep, season: current_season, name: format!("Bölüm {target_ep}") };
                                    if let Ok(next_url) = client_c.resolve(title_c.id, target_ep, current_season) {
                                        current_ep = target_ep;
                                        op_prompted = false; ed_prompted = false;
                                        let json_cmd = format!("{{\"command\":[\"loadfile\", \"{}\"]}}\n", next_url);
                                        crate::player::send_mpv_cmd(&sock_c, &json_cmd);
                                        let json_osd = format!("{{\"command\":[\"show-text\", \"▶️ Bölüm {} Açıldı\", 3000]}}\n", target_ep);
                                        crate::player::send_mpv_cmd(&sock_c, &json_osd);
                                        let w = api::Watched { title_id: title_c.id, episode: target_ep, season: current_season };
                                        client_c.save_watched(&w, &title_c.name);
                                        client_c.add_history(&title_c, &target);
                                    } else {
                                        crate::player::send_mpv_cmd(&sock_c, "{\"command\":[\"show-text\", \"⚠️ Sonraki Bölüm Bulunamadı\", 3000]}\n");
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        let (pos, dur) = crate::player::query_mpv_position(&sock_c).unwrap_or((0.0,0.0));
                        if let Some(st) = aniskip_c.op_start {
                            if !op_prompted && pos >= (st-1.5) && pos <= (st+10.0) {
                                op_prompted = true;
                                crate::player::send_mpv_cmd(&sock_c, "{\"command\":[\"show-text\", \"⏩ İntro Başladı ('s' ile atlayabilirsiniz)\", 7000]}\n");
                            }
                        }
                        if let Some(st) = aniskip_c.ed_start {
                            if !ed_prompted && pos >= (st-1.5) && pos <= (st+10.0) {
                                ed_prompted = true;
                                crate::player::send_mpv_cmd(&sock_c, "{\"command\":[\"show-text\", \"🏁 Outro Başladı ('n' ile Sonraki Bölüm)\", 7000]}\n");
                            }
                        }
                        if sender_c.send((pos, dur)).is_err() { break; }
                    } else {
                        // socket kayboldu; oturum bitmediyse yeniden bekle
                        if !alive.get() { break; }
                        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(250));
                        continue;
                    }
                    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500));
                }
            });

            let progress3 = progress2.clone();
            let progress_bars3 = progress_bars2.clone();
            let client_prog = client.clone();
            let pk = prog_key.clone();
            let receiver = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(receiver));
            glib::timeout_add_local(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500), move || {
                let rx = receiver.lock().unwrap();
                let mut latest: Option<(f64,f64)> = None;
                let mut disconnected = false;
                loop {
                    match rx.try_recv() {
                        Ok(v) => latest = Some(v),
                        Err(std::sync::mpsc::TryRecvError::Empty) => break,
                        Err(std::sync::mpsc::TryRecvError::Disconnected) => { disconnected = true; break; }
                    }
                }
                drop(rx);
                if disconnected {
                    let last = progress3.borrow().get(&pk).copied();
                    if let Some((pos,dur)) = last { client_prog.save_progress(tid, season, episode, pos, dur); }
                    return glib::ControlFlow::Break;
                }
                if let Some((pos,dur)) = latest {
                    if pos < 1.0 { return glib::ControlFlow::Continue; }
                    progress3.borrow_mut().insert(pk.clone(), (pos,dur));
                    if let Some((pb,lbl)) = progress_bars3.borrow().get(&pk) {
                        if dur > 0.0 {
                            pb.set_fraction((pos/dur).clamp(0.0,1.0));
                            let fmt = |s: f64| -> String { let s=s as u64; if s>=3600 {format!("{}:{:02}:{:02}", s/3600,(s%3600)/60,s%60)} else {format!("{}:{:02}", s/60, s%60)} };
                            lbl.set_text(&format!("{} / {}", fmt(pos), fmt(dur)));
                            lbl.set_visible(true); pb.set_visible(true);
                        }
                    }
                    client_prog.save_progress(tid, season, episode, pos, dur);
                }
                glib::ControlFlow::Continue
            });
        });
    }

    // Kaynak deneme (supervisor) iş parçacığı
    {
        let alive = session_alive.clone();
        let sock_path_c = sock_path.clone();
        let cmd_file_c = cmd_file.clone();
        let input_conf_path_c = input_conf_path.clone();
        let media_title_c = media_title.clone();
        let toast_c = toast.clone();
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let mut success = false;
            for (i, url) in candidates.iter().enumerate() {
                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&cmd_file_c);
                let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new("mpv");
                cmd.arg("--no-terminal")
                    .arg("--force-window")
                    .arg("--autofit=90%")
                    .arg(format!("--title={media_title_c}"))
                    .arg(format!("--input-ipc-server={sock_path_c}"))
                    .arg(format!("--input-conf={input_conf_path_c}"))
                    .arg("--script-opts=osc-visibility=always")
                    .arg("--osd-level=1")
                    .arg(format!("--save-position-on-quit"))
                    .arg(url);
                if auto_fullscreen { cmd.arg("--fullscreen"); }
                if let Some(start) = saved_pos {
                    if start > 1.0 { cmd.arg(format!("--start={start}")); }
                }
                let child = match cmd.spawn() {
                    Ok(c) => c,
                    Err(e) => { eprintln!("mpv başlatılamadı: {e}"); continue; }
                };
                // socket oluşana ya da erken çıkana kadar bekle
                let start = std::time::Instant::now();
                let mut opened = false;
                loop {
                    if Path::new(&sock_path_c).exists() { opened = true; break; }
                    match child.try_wait() {
                        Ok(Some(_)) => break,
                        Ok(None) => {},
                        Err(_) => break,
                    }
                    if start.elapsed() > std::time::Duration::from_secs(15) { break; }
                    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(200));
                }
                if opened {
                    success = true;
                    let _ = child.wait();  // kullanıcı kapatana kadar bekle
                    break;
                } else {
                    let _ = child.kill();
                    let _ = child.wait();
                    if i + 1 < candidates.len() {
                        let t = adw::Toast::new("Kaynak açılamadı, diğer kaynağa geçiliyor…");
                        t.set_timeout(3);
                        toast_c.add_toast(t);
                        continue;
                    } else {
                        let t = adw::Toast::new("Bölüm hiçbir kaynakta açılamadı.");
                        t.set_timeout(4);
                        toast_c.add_toast(t);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            alive.set(false);
            let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&sock_path_c);
        });
    }
}
```

```rust
    fn play_candidates(&self, title: &Title, ep: &Episode, candidates: &[String]) {
        let w = api::Watched {
            title_id: title.id,
            episode: ep.episode,
            season: ep.season,
        };
        self.client.save_watched(&w, &title.name);
        self.client.add_history(&title, &ep);

        let media_title = format!("{} | S{:02}E{:02}", title.name, ep.season, ep.episode);
        let tid = title.id;
        let season = ep.season;
        let episode = ep.episode;
        let prog_key = format!("{tid}:{season}:{episode}");

        let saved_pos = self.client.get_progress(tid, season, episode)
            .filter(|(pos, dur)| *pos > 5.0 && *dur > 0.0 && *pos / *dur < 0.95)
            .map(|(pos, _)| pos);

        let sock_path = format!("/tmp/animecix-mpv-{tid}-{season}-{episode}.sock");
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&sock_path);

        let auto_fullscreen = self.settings.borrow().auto_fullscreen;
        let aniskip = if self.settings.borrow().aniskip_enabled {
            self.client.fetch_aniskip_timestamps(&title.name, episode)
        } else {
            api::AniSkipTimes::default()
        };

        let fmt_sec = |sec: f64| -> String {
            let s = sec as u64;
            format!("{:02}:{:02}", s / 60, s % 60)
        };

        let skip_cmd = if let (Some(st), Some(et)) = (aniskip.op_start, aniskip.op_end) {
            format!("s seek {et:.1} absolute; show-text \"⏩ İntro Atlandı (AniSkip: {} → {})\" 3000\n", fmt_sec(st), fmt_sec(et))
        } else {
            "s show-text \"⚠️ İntro zamanı bulunamadı (AniSkip)\" 2500\n".to_string()
        };

        let outro_cmd = if let (Some(st), Some(et)) = (aniskip.ed_start, aniskip.ed_end) {
            format!("e seek {et:.1} absolute; show-text \"⏩ Outro Atlandı (AniSkip: {} → {})\" 3000\n", fmt_sec(st), fmt_sec(et))
        } else {
            "e show-text \"⚠️ Outro zamanı bulunamadı (AniSkip)\" 2500\n".to_string()
        };

        let cmd_file = format!("/tmp/animecix-cmd-{tid}.cmd");
        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&cmd_file);

        let input_conf_path = format!("/tmp/animecix-input-{tid}.conf");
        let input_conf_content = format!(
            "{skip_cmd}\
             {outro_cmd}\
             S seek -30; show-text \"⏪ 30s Geri\" 2000\n\
             n run \"sh\" \"-c\" \"echo next > {cmd_file}\"; show-text \"⏳ Sonraki Bölüm Yükleniyor...\" 4000\n\
             N run \"sh\" \"-c\" \"echo next > {cmd_file}\"; show-text \"⏳ Sonraki Bölüm Yükleniyor...\" 4000\n\
             p run \"sh\" \"-c\" \"echo prev > {cmd_file}\"; show-text \"⏳ Önceki Bölüm Yükleniyor...\" 4000\n\
             P run \"sh\" \"-c\" \"echo prev > {cmd_file}\"; show-text \"⏳ Önceki Bölüm Yükleniyor...\" 4000\n"
        );
        let _ = std::fs::write(&input_conf_path, input_conf_content);

        let progress = self.progress.clone();
        let progress_bars = self.progress_bars.clone();
        let client = self.client.clone();
        let toast = self.toast.clone();
        let main_ctx = glib::MainContext::default();

        let t = adw::Toast::new(&format!(
            "▶ {media_title} açılıyor…{}",
            saved_pos.map(|p| {
                let s = p as u64;
                if s >= 3600 { format!(" ({}:{:02}:{:02}'den)", s/3600, (s%3600)/60, s%60) }
                else { format!(" ({}:{:02}'den)", s/60, s%60) }
            }).unwrap_or_default()
        ));
        t.set_timeout(3);
        self.toast.add_toast(t);

        let alive = std::rc::Rc::new(std::cell::Cell::new(true));

        // İzleme (progress / n-p / aniskip) işçi iş parçacığı — tüm denemeler boyunca yaşar
        {
            let alive = alive.clone();
            let sock_poll = sock_path.clone();
            let sock_c = sock_path.clone();
            let cmd_c = cmd_file.clone();
            let aniskip_c = aniskip.clone();
            let client_c = client.clone();
            let title_c = title.clone();
            let ep_c = ep.clone();
            let (sender, receiver) = std::sync::mpsc::channel::<(f64, f64)>();
            std::thread::spawn(move || {
                let mut current_ep = ep_c.episode;
                let mut current_season = ep_c.season;
                let mut op_prompted = false;
                let mut ed_prompted = false;

                // Soket belirene kadar bekle
                while alive.get() && !std::path::Path::new(&sock_poll).exists() {
                    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500));
                }
                if !alive.get() { return; }

                loop {
                    if std::path::Path::new(&sock_c).exists() {
                        // MPV içi 'n' / 'p' kısayolu
                        if std::path::Path::new(&cmd_c).exists() {
                            if let Ok(cmd_str) = std::fs::read_to_string(&cmd_c) {
                                let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&cmd_c);
                                let target_ep = if cmd_str.trim() == "next" {
                                    current_ep + 1
                                } else if current_ep > 1 {
                                    current_ep - 1
                                } else {
                                    1
                                };
                                if target_ep != current_ep {
                                    let target = Episode {
                                        episode: target_ep,
                                        season: current_season,
                                        name: format!("Bölüm {target_ep}"),
                                    };
                                    if let Ok(next_url) = client_c.resolve(title_c.id, target_ep, current_season) {
                                        current_ep = target_ep;
                                        op_prompted = false;
                                        ed_prompted = false;
                                        let json_cmd = format!("{{\"command\":[\"loadfile\", \"{}\"]}}\n", next_url);
                                        crate::player::send_mpv_cmd(&sock_c, &json_cmd);
                                        let json_osd = format!("{{\"command\":[\"show-text\", \"▶️ Bölüm {} Açıldı\", 3000]}}\n", target_ep);
                                        crate::player::send_mpv_cmd(&sock_c, &json_osd);
                                        let w = api::Watched { title_id: title_c.id, episode: target_ep, season: current_season };
                                        client_c.save_watched(&w, &title_c.name);
                                        client_c.add_history(&title_c, &target);
                                    } else {
                                        crate::player::send_mpv_cmd(&sock_c, "{\"command\":[\"show-text\", \"⚠️ Sonraki Bölüm Bulunamadı\", 3000]}\n");
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        let (pos, dur) = crate::player::query_mpv_position(&sock_c).unwrap_or((0.0, 0.0));
                        if let Some(st) = aniskip_c.op_start {
                            if !op_prompted && pos >= (st - 1.5) && pos <= (st + 10.0) {
                                op_prompted = true;
                                crate::player::send_mpv_cmd(&sock_c, "{\"command\":[\"show-text\", \"⏩ İntro Başladı ('s' ile atlayabilirsiniz)\", 7000]}\n");
                            }
                        }
                        if let Some(st) = aniskip_c.ed_start {
                            if !ed_prompted && pos >= (st - 1.5) && pos <= (st + 10.0) {
                                ed_prompted = true;
                                crate::player::send_mpv_cmd(&sock_c, "{\"command\":[\"show-text\", \"🏁 Outro Başladı ('n' ile Sonraki Bölüm)\", 7000]}\n");
                            }
                        }
                        if sender.send((pos, dur)).is_err() { break; }
                    } else {
                        if !alive.get() { break; }
                        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(250));
                        continue;
                    }
                    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500));
                }
            });

            let progress2 = progress.clone();
            let progress_bars2 = progress_bars.clone();
            let client_prog = client.clone();
            let pk = prog_key.clone();
            let receiver = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(receiver));
            glib::timeout_add_local(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500), move || {
                let rx = receiver.lock().unwrap();
                let mut latest: Option<(f64, f64)> = None;
                let mut disconnected = false;
                loop {
                    match rx.try_recv() {
                        Ok(v) => { latest = Some(v); }
                        Err(std::sync::mpsc::TryRecvError::Empty) => break,
                        Err(std::sync::mpsc::TryRecvError::Disconnected) => { disconnected = true; break; }
                    }
                }
                drop(rx);
                if disconnected {
                    let last = progress2.borrow().get(&pk).copied();
                    if let Some((pos, dur)) = last {
                        client_prog.save_progress(tid, season, episode, pos, dur);
                    }
                    return glib::ControlFlow::Break;
                }
                if let Some((pos, dur)) = latest {
                    if pos < 1.0 { return glib::ControlFlow::Continue; }
                    progress2.borrow_mut().insert(pk.clone(), (pos, dur));
                    if let Some((pb, lbl)) = progress_bars2.borrow().get(&pk) {
                        if dur > 0.0 {
                            pb.set_fraction((pos / dur).clamp(0.0, 1.0));
                            let fmt = |s: f64| -> String {
                                let s = s as u64;
                                if s >= 3600 { format!("{}:{:02}:{:02}", s/3600, (s%3600)/60, s%60) }
                                else { format!("{}:{:02}", s/60, s%60) }
                            };
                            lbl.set_text(&format!("{} / {}", fmt(pos), fmt(dur)));
                            lbl.set_visible(true);
                            pb.set_visible(true);
                        }
                    }
                    client_prog.save_progress(tid, season, episode, pos, dur);
                }
                glib::ControlFlow::Continue
            });
        }

        // Kaynak deneme (supervisor) iş parçacığı — en iyi kaliteli önce, başarısız olursa sıradakine geç
        {
            let alive = alive.clone();
            let sock_path_c = sock_path.clone();
            let cmd_file_c = cmd_file.clone();
            let input_conf_path_c = input_conf_path.clone();
            let media_title_c = media_title.clone();
            let toast_c = toast.clone();
            let main_ctx_c = main_ctx.clone();
            let saved_pos_c = saved_pos;
            let auto_fullscreen_c = auto_fullscreen;
            let candidates: Vec<String> = candidates.to_vec();
            std::thread::spawn(move || {
                for (i, url) in candidates.iter().enumerate() {

                    cmd.arg("--user-agent=mozilla")
                        .arg(format!("--force-media-title={media_title_c}"))
                        .arg("--keep-open=yes")
                        .arg(format!("--input-ipc-server={sock_path_c}"));
                    if auto_fullscreen_c { cmd.arg("--fullscreen"); }
                    cmd.arg(format!("--input-conf={input_conf_path_c}"));
                    cmd.args(saved_pos_c.map(|p| format!("--start={p:.1}")).as_slice())
                        .arg("--cache=yes")
                        .arg("--demuxer-max-bytes=128MiB")
                        .arg("--demuxer-max-back-bytes=32MiB")
                        .arg("--demuxer-readahead-secs=120")
                        .arg("--cache-pause=yes")
                        .arg("--cache-pause-wait=3")
                        .arg("--cache-secs=120")
                        .arg("--stream-lavf-o=reconnect=1,reconnect_streamed=1,reconnect_delay_max=5")
                        .arg("--network-timeout=10")
                        .arg("--hwdec=auto-safe")
                        .arg("--ytdl-format=bestvideo[height<=1080]+bestaudio/best")
                        .arg(url);
                    let child = match cmd.spawn() {
                        Ok(c) => c,
                        Err(e) => { eprintln!("mpv başlatılamadı: {e}"); continue; }
                    };
                    let start = std::time::Instant::now();

                            Ok(Some(_)) => break,
                            Ok(None) => {},
```

```
#[test]
fn next_episode_not_marked_watched_before_playing() {
    let c = Client::new();
    let tid: u64 = 999_991;
    let w1 = Watched { title_id: tid, episode: 1, season: 0 };
    let w2 = Watched { title_id: tid, episode: 2, season: 0 };

    // Açılışta yalnızca "şu an izlenen" güncellenir, izlendi listesine eklenmez
    c.set_current(&w1);
    assert!(!c.is_watched(tid, 0, 1), "açılan bölüm henüz izlenmedi sayılmamalı");

    assert!(!Client::played_enough(45.0, 100.0));
    assert!(!Client::played_enough(0.0, 0.0));
    c.save_watched(&w1, "");
    assert!(c.is_watched(tid, 0, 1), "eşik aşılınca izlendi sayılmalı");

    // Sonraki bölüme geçiş (set_current) izlenmeden "tamamlandı" işaretlememeli

    // Sonraki bölüm de izlenince işaretlenir

    assert!(c.is_watched(tid, 0, 2));

    // temizlik: gerçek state dosyasını kirletmeyelim
    c.remove_watched(tid, 0, 1);
    c.remove_watched(tid, 0, 2);
    let mut st = c.load_state();
    st.current = None;
    c.save_state(&st);
}
```

Let me write `download_update`:
```
pub fn download_update<F>(url: &str, target: &Path, mut on_progress: F) -> Result<(), String>
where F: FnMut(u64, u64) + Send + 'static {
    let rt = futures::executor::block_on(async {
        let client = reqwest::Client::builder().user_agent("animecix-updater").build().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let resp = client.get(url).send().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        if !resp.status().is_success() { return Err(format!("İndirme hatası: {}", resp.status())); }
        let total = resp.content_length().unwrap_or(0);
        let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(total as usize);
        let mut stream = resp.bytes_stream();
        use futures::StreamExt;
        while let Some(chunk) = stream.next().await {
            let chunk = chunk.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            buf.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
            on_progress(buf.len() as u64, total);
        }
        Ok::<Vec<u8>, String>(buf)
    });
    let bytes = rt?;
    replace_target(&bytes, target)
}
```
This uses `reqwest::Client` (async) with `stream` feature, and `futures::executor::block_on` + `futures::StreamExt`. Need `futures` dep with `executor` and `async-await` features (default). And reqwest `stream` feature.

Let me write `download_update`:
```
/// İndirir ve hedefin üstüne yazar; indirme ilerlemesini `on_progress(indirilen, toplam)` ile bildirir.
pub fn download_update<F>(url: &str, target: &Path, mut on_progress: F) -> Result<(), String>
where
    F: FnMut(u64, u64) + Send + 'static,
{
    let bytes = futures::executor::block_on(async {
        let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
            .user_agent("animecix-updater")
            .build()
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let resp = client
            .get(url)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        if !resp.status().is_success() {
            return Err(format!("İndirme hatası: {}", resp.status()));
        }
        let total = resp.content_length().unwrap_or(0);
        let mut buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::with_capacity(total as usize);
        let mut stream = resp.bytes_stream();
        use futures::StreamExt;
        while let Some(chunk) = stream.next().await {
            let chunk = chunk.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            buf.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
            on_progress(buf.len() as u64, total);
        }
        Ok::<Vec<u8>, String>(buf)
    })?;
    replace_target(&bytes, target)
}
```

```
#[derive(Clone)]
enum UpdMsg {
    Progress(u64, u64),
    Step(String),
    Done,
    Error(String),
}

fn present_update_dialog<W: IsA<gtk::Window>>(window: &W, tag: &str, url: &str) {
    let tag = tag.trim_start_matches('v').to_string();
    let target = std::env::var("APPIMAGE").unwrap_or_default();
    if target.is_empty() {
        present_info(window, "Güncelleme Başarısız", "AppImage yolu bulunamadı.");
        return;
    }
    let dialog = adw::MessageDialog::builder()
        .heading("Yeni Sürüm Mevcut")
        .body(format!("AnimeciX v{tag} yayınlandı. İndirip uygulamayı güncelleyelim mi?"))
        .close_response("later")
        .default_response("later")
        .build();
    dialog.add_response("later", "Daha Sonra");
    dialog.add_response("update", "Güncelle ve Yeniden Başlat");
    dialog.set_response_appearance("update", adw::ResponseAppearance::Suggested);
    dialog.set_transient_for(Some(window));
    dialog.connect_response(None, move |dlg, resp| {
        if resp == "update" {
            dlg.close();
            run_update_with_progress(window, &url, &target);
        }
    });
    dialog.present();
}

fn run_update_with_progress<W: IsA<gtk::Window> + Clone + 'static>(
    window: W,
    url: &str,
    target: &str,
) {
    let dlg = adw::Window::builder()
        .title("Güncelleniyor")
        .modal(true)
        .transient_for(&window)
        .default_width(380)
        .build();
    dlg.set_deletable(false);
    let box_ = gtk::Box::new(gtk::Orientation::Vertical, 12);
    box_.set_margin_top(18);
    box_.set_margin_bottom(18);
    box_.set_margin_start(18);
    box_.set_margin_end(18);
    let label = gtk::Label::new(Some("Güncelleme başlatılıyor…"));
    let bar = gtk::ProgressBar::new();
    bar.set_show_text(true);
    bar.set_text(Some("0%"));
    bar.set_fraction(0.0);
    box_.append(&label);
    box_.append(&bar);
    dlg.set_content(Some(&box_));
    dlg.present();

    let url = url.to_string();
    let target = target.to_string();
    start_update_worker(&dlg, &label, &bar, &window, &url, &target);
}

fn start_update_worker<W: IsA<gtk::Window> + Clone + 'static>(
    dlg: &adw::Window,
    label: &gtk::Label,
    bar: &gtk::ProgressBar,
    window: &W,
    url: &str,
    target: &str,
) {
    let (tx, rx) = channel::<UpdMsg>();
    let url = url.to_string();
    let target_path = std::path::PathBuf::from(target);
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        tx.send(UpdMsg::Step("İndiriliyor…".into())).ok();
        let result = download_update(&url, &target_path, |cur, total| {
            let _ = tx.send(UpdMsg::Progress(cur, total));
        });
        match result {
            Ok(()) => {
                tx.send(UpdMsg::Step("Doğrulanıyor ve yükleniyor…".into())).ok();
                tx.send(UpdMsg::Done).ok();
            }
            Err(e) => {
                tx.send(UpdMsg::Error(e)).ok();
            }
        }
    });

    let dlg = dlg.clone();
    let label = label.clone();
    let bar = bar.clone();
    let window = window.clone();
    let url = url.to_string();
    let target = target.to_string();
    glib::idle_add_local(move || {
        match rx.try_recv() {
            Ok(UpdMsg::Progress(cur, total)) => {
                if total > 0 {
                    let f = (cur as f64 / total as f64).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    bar.set_fraction(f);
                    bar.set_text(Some(&format!("{}%", (f * 100.0) as u32)));
                } else {
                    bar.pulse();
                    bar.set_text(Some(&format!("{} KB", cur / 1024)));
                }
                ControlFlow::Continue
            }
            Ok(UpdMsg::Step(s)) => {
                label.set_text(&s);
                ControlFlow::Continue
            }
            Ok(UpdMsg::Done) => {
                label.set_text("Yeniden başlatılıyor…");
                bar.set_fraction(1.0);
                bar.set_text(Some("100%"));
                let _ = std::process::Command::new(&target).spawn();
                std::process::exit(0);
            }
            Ok(UpdMsg::Error(e)) => {
                label.set_text(&format!("Güncelleme başarısız: {e}"));
                bar.set_fraction(0.0);
                // Tekrar dene butonu
                let retry = gtk::Button::with_label("Tekrar Dene");
                retry.set_margin_top(8);
                let dlg2 = dlg.clone();
                let win2 = window.clone();
                let url2 = url.clone();
                let target2 = target.clone();
                retry.connect_clicked(move |_| {
                    dlg2.close();
                    run_update_with_progress(&win2, &url2, &target2);
                });
                // box'a ekle: dlg content'i box; ama content set edildi. 
                ... need access to box ...
                ControlFlow::Break
            }
            Err(std::sync::mpsc::TryRecvError::Empty) => ControlFlow::Continue,
            Err(std::sync::mpsc::TryRecvError::Disconnected) => ControlFlow::Break,
        }
    });
}
```

For the test server, I'll add tests in update.rs tests module:
```
#[test]
fn download_update_works() {
    // basit bir yerel HTTP sunucu aç, ELF dosyası sun, download_update ile indir + replace doğrula
    let elf = b"\x7fELF....appimagecontent";
    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    let port = addr.port();
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        for stream in listener.incoming().take(1) {
            let mut s = stream.unwrap();
            let body = elf;
            let resp = format!("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nContent-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n", body.len());
            s.write_all(resp.as_bytes()).unwrap();
            s.write_all(body).unwrap();
            s.flush().unwrap();
        }
    });
    let url = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}/AnimeciX-x86_64.AppImage", port);
    let target = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("animecix-dl-test-{}.AppImage", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&target);
    let mut last = (0u64,0u64);
    let r = download_update(&url, &target, |cur,total| { last = (cur,total); });
    assert!(r.is_ok(), "indirme başarısız: {:?}", r.err());
    assert!(target.exists());
    let content = std::fs::read(&target).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(content, elf);
    assert_eq!(last.1, elf.len() as u64);
    std::fs::remove_file(&target).ok();
}
```
`TcpListener::incoming()` returns an iterator; `.take(1)` ok. `write_all` needs `use std::io::Write;`. Add.

Note: reqwest async client uses its own runtime; connecting to 127.0.0.1 http works without TLS. Good. `content_length()` will be set from Content-Length header → total = elf.len(). Progress final == total. Good.

```
/// İndirir ve hedefin üstüne yazar; indirme ilerlemesini `on_progress(indirilen, toplam)` ile bildirir.
pub fn download_update<F>(url: &str, target: &Path, mut on_progress: F) -> Result<(), String>
where
    F: FnMut(u64, u64) + Send + 'static,
{
    let bytes = futures::executor::block_on(async {
        let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
            .user_agent("animecix-updater")
            .build()
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let resp = client
            .get(url)
            .send()
            .await
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        if !resp.status().is_success() {
            return Err(format!("İndirme hatası: {}", resp.status()));
        }
        let total = resp.content_length().unwrap_or(0);
        let mut buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::with_capacity(total as usize);
        let mut stream = resp.bytes_stream();
        use futures::StreamExt;
        while let Some(chunk) = stream.next().await {
            let chunk = chunk.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            buf.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
            on_progress(buf.len() as u64, total);
        }
        Ok::<Vec<u8>, String>(buf)
    })?;
    replace_target(&bytes, target)
}
```

```
#[derive(Clone)]
enum UpdMsg {
    Progress(u64, u64),
    Step(String),
    Done,
    Error(String),
}

fn present_update_dialog<W: IsA<gtk::Window> + Clone + 'static>(
    window: &W,
    tag: &str,
    url: &str,
) {
    let tag = tag.trim_start_matches('v').to_string();
    let url = url.to_string();
    let target = std::env::var("APPIMAGE").unwrap_or_default();
    if target.is_empty() {
        present_info(window, "Güncelleme Başarısız", "AppImage yolu bulunamadı.");
        return;
    }
    let dialog = adw::MessageDialog::builder()
        .heading("Yeni Sürüm Mevcut")
        .body(format!(
            "AnimeciX v{tag} yayınlandı. İndirip uygulamayı güncelleyelim mi?"
        ))
        .close_response("later")
        .default_response("later")
        .build();
    dialog.add_response("later", "Daha Sonra");
    dialog.add_response("update", "Güncelle ve Yeniden Başlat");
    dialog.set_response_appearance("update", adw::ResponseAppearance::Suggested);
    dialog.set_transient_for(Some(window));
    dialog.connect_response(None, move |dlg, resp| {
        if resp == "update" {
            dlg.close();
            run_update_with_progress(window.clone(), &url, &target);
        }
    });
    dialog.present();
}

fn run_update_with_progress<W: IsA<gtk::Window> + Clone + 'static>(
    window: W,
    url: &str,
    target: &str,
) {
    let dlg = adw::Window::builder()
        .title("Güncelleniyor")
        .modal(true)
        .transient_for(&window)
        .default_width(380)
        .build();
    dlg.set_deletable(false);
    let box_ = gtk::Box::new(gtk::Orientation::Vertical, 12);
    box_.set_margin_top(18);
    box_.set_margin_bottom(18);
    box_.set_margin_start(18);
    box_.set_margin_end(18);
    let label = gtk::Label::new(Some("Güncelleme başlatılıyor…"));
    let bar = gtk::ProgressBar::new();
    bar.set_show_text(true);
    bar.set_text(Some("0%"));
    bar.set_fraction(0.0);
    box_.append(&label);
    box_.append(&bar);
    dlg.set_content(Some(&box_));
    dlg.present();

    let url = url.to_string();
    let target = target.to_string();
    start_update_worker(&dlg, &label, &bar, &window, &url, &target);
}

fn start_update_worker<W: IsA<gtk::Window> + Clone + 'static>(
    dlg: &adw::Window,
    label: &gtk::Label,
    bar: &gtk::ProgressBar,
    window: &W,
    url: &str,
    target: &str,
) {
    let (tx, rx) = channel::<UpdMsg>();
    let url = url.to_string();
    let target_path = std::path::PathBuf::from(target);
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        tx.send(UpdMsg::Step("İndiriliyor…".into())).ok();
        let result = download_update(&url, &target_path, |cur, total| {
            let _ = tx.send(UpdMsg::Progress(cur, total));
        });
        match result {
            Ok(()) => {
                let _ = tx.send(UpdMsg::Step("Doğrulanıyor ve yükleniyor…".into()));
                let _ = tx.send(UpdMsg::Done);
            }
            Err(e) => {
                let _ = tx.send(UpdMsg::Error(e));
            }
        }
    });

    let dlg = dlg.clone();
    let label = label.clone();
    let bar = bar.clone();
    let window = window.clone();
    let url = url.to_string();
    let target = target.to_string();
    glib::idle_add_local(move || {
        match rx.try_recv() {
            Ok(UpdMsg::Progress(cur, total)) => {
                if total > 0 {
                    let f = (cur as f64 / total as f64).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    bar.set_fraction(f);
                    bar.set_text(Some(&format!("{}%", (f * 100.0) as u32)));
                } else {
                    bar.pulse();
                    bar.set_text(Some(&format!("{} KB", cur / 1024)));
                }
                ControlFlow::Continue
            }
            Ok(UpdMsg::Step(s)) => {
                label.set_text(&s);
                ControlFlow::Continue
            }
            Ok(UpdMsg::Done) => {
                label.set_text("Yeniden başlatılıyor…");
                bar.set_fraction(1.0);
                bar.set_text(Some("100%"));
                let _ = std::process::Command::new(&target).spawn();
                std::process::exit(0);
            }
            Ok(UpdMsg::Error(e)) => {
                label.set_text(&format!("Güncelleme başarısız: {e}"));
                bar.set_fraction(0.0);
                dlg.set_deletable(true);
                if let Some(b) = dlg.content().and_downcast::<gtk::Box>() {
                    if b.last_child().is_none()
                        || b.last_child().and_downcast::<gtk::Button>().is_none()
                    {
                        let retry = gtk::Button::with_label("Tekrar Dene");
                        retry.set_margin_top(8);
                        let dlg2 = dlg.clone();
                        let win2 = window.clone();
                        let url2 = url.clone();
                        let target2 = target.clone();
                        retry.connect_clicked(move |_| {
                            dlg2.close();
                            run_update_with_progress(&win2, &url2, &target2);
                        });
                        b.append(&retry);
                    }
                }
                ControlFlow::Break
            }
            Err(std::sync::mpsc::TryRecvError::Empty) => ControlFlow::Continue,
            Err(std::sync::mpsc::TryRecvError::Disconnected) => ControlFlow::Break,
        }
    });
```

```
#[test]
fn download_update_writes_target() {
    use std::io::Write;
    let elf = b"\x7fELF-appimage-body-content-here";
    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    let port = addr.port();
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        for stream in listener.incoming().take(1) {
            let mut s = stream.unwrap();
            let resp = format!(
                "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nContent-Type: application/octet-stream\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
                elf.len()
            );
            s.write_all(resp.as_bytes()).unwrap();
            s.write_all(elf).unwrap();
            s.flush().unwrap();
        }
    });
    let url = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{}/AnimeciX-x86_64.AppImage", port);
    let target = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("animecix-dl-test-{}.AppImage", std::process::id()));
    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&target);
    let mut last = (0u64, 0u64);
    let r = download_update(&url, &target, |cur, total| last = (cur, total));
    assert!(r.is_ok(), "indirme başarısız: {:?}", r.err());
    assert!(target.exists());
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(&target).unwrap(), elf);
    assert_eq!(last.1, elf.len() as u64);
    assert_eq!(last.0, elf.len() as u64);
    std::fs::remove_file(&target).ok();
}
```

Now `download_update`:
```
pub fn download_update<F>(url: &str, target: &Path, mut on_progress: F) -> Result<(), String>
where
    F: FnMut(u64, u64) + Send + 'static,
{
    let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()
        .enable_all()
        .build()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let bytes = rt.block_on(async {
        let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
            .user_agent("animecix-updater")
            .build()
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let resp = client.get(url).send().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        if !resp.status().is_success() {
            return Err(format!("İndirme hatası: {}", resp.status()));
        }
        let total = resp.content_length().unwrap_or(0);
        let mut buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::with_capacity(total as usize);
        let mut stream = resp.bytes_stream();
        use futures::StreamExt;
        while let Some(chunk) = stream.next().await {
            let chunk = chunk.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            buf.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
            on_progress(buf.len() as u64, total);
        }
        Ok::<Vec<u8>, String>(buf)
    })?;
    replace_target(&bytes, target)
}
```

```
fn start_update_worker<W: IsA<gtk::Window> + Clone + 'static>(
    dlg: &adw::Window,
    label: &gtk::Label,
    bar: &gtk::ProgressBar,
    window: &W,
    url: &str,
    target: &str,
) {
    let (tx, rx) = channel::<UpdMsg>();
    let url_s = url.to_string();
    let target_path = std::path::PathBuf::from(target);
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let _ = tx.send(UpdMsg::Step("İndiriliyor…".into()));
        let result = download_update(&url_s, &target_path, |cur, total| {
            let _ = tx.send(UpdMsg::Progress(cur, total));
        });
        match result {
            Ok(()) => {
                let _ = tx.send(UpdMsg::Step("Doğrulanıyor ve yükleniyor…".into()));
                let _ = tx.send(UpdMsg::Done);
            }
            Err(e) => {
                let _ = tx.send(UpdMsg::Error(e));
            }
        }
    });

    let dlg = dlg.clone();
    let label = label.clone();
    let bar = bar.clone();
    let window = window.clone();
    let url_c = url.to_string();
    let target_c = target.to_string();
    glib::idle_add_local(move || {
        match rx.try_recv() {
            ...
            Ok(UpdMsg::Error(e)) => {
                label.set_text(&format!("Güncelleme başarısız: {e}"));
                bar.set_fraction(0.0);
                dlg.set_deletable(true);
                if let Some(b) = dlg.content().and_then(|w| w.downcast::<gtk::Box>().ok()) {
                    let has_retry = b.last_child().and_then(|w| w.downcast::<gtk::Button>().ok())
                        .map(|btn| btn.label().as_deref() == Some("Tekrar Dene"))
                        .unwrap_or(false);
                    if !has_retry {
                        let retry = gtk::Button::with_label("Tekrar Dene");
                        retry.set_margin_top(8);
                        let dlg2 = dlg.clone();
                        let win2 = window.clone();
                        let url2 = url_c.clone();
                        let target2 = target_c.clone();
                        retry.connect_clicked(move |_| {
                            dlg2.close();
                            run_update_with_progress(win2, &url2, &target2);
                        });
                        b.append(&retry);
                    }
                }
                ControlFlow::Break
            }
            ...
        }
    });
}
```

### ASSISTANT:
Done. Let me summarize to the user what the bug was and that it's fixed in v1.1.0.

Explanation: I added an episode-source fallback. When a source fails to open, it tries the next. But my "did it open?" check required the video's duration to be > 0 within 20 seconds. Many working streams don't report a duration right away (or at all), so the working source got killed and the next tried, eventually exhausting all — so the episode never opened. The old code just launched MPV and left it; it never gated on duration. I removed the duration>0 requirement: now a source is considered "opened" as soon as MPV creates its IPC socket and is still running. That restores the old behavior (all episodes open) while keeping the fallback for sources that actually crash/exit.

I should mention: fallback now triggers only when a source process actually exits (crashes/404 that causes MPV to exit). With `--keep-open=yes`, sources that show an MPV error dialog stay open (same as before), so fallback won't switch for those — same as old system.

```rust
pub fn display_name(&self) -> String {
    match self.year {
        Some(y) => format!("{} ({})", self.name, y),
        None => self.name.clone(),
    }
}

fn tr_genre(s: &str) -> String { /* map */ }

pub fn genre_line(&self) -> Option<String> {
    let gens = self.genres.as_ref()?;
    let mut parts: Vec<String> = gens.iter()
        .map(|g| Self::tr_genre(g))
        .filter(|g| g != "Animasyon" && g != "Animation")  // drop redundant
        .collect();
    parts.dedup();
    if parts.is_empty() { None } else { Some(parts.join("  •  ")) }
}

pub fn detail_meta(&self) -> String {
    // builds "24 dakika\n•\n38 bölüm\n•\n29/9/2023"
    let mut lines = Vec::new();
    if let Some(rt) = self.runtime {
        if rt > 0 { lines.push(format!("{} dakika", rt)); }
    }
    if let Some(ec) = self.episode_count {
        if ec > 0 { lines.push(format!("{} bölüm", ec)); }
    } else if self.title_type.as_deref() == Some("movie") {
        lines.push("Film".to_string());
    }
    if let Some(rd) = &self.release_date {
        if let Some(d) = parse_release_date(rd) { lines.push(d); }
    }
    // join with bullet lines
    lines.iter().enumerate().flat_map(|(i,l)| {
        if i == 0 { vec![l.clone()] } else { vec!["•".to_string(), l.clone()] }
    }).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n")
}
```

parse_release_date("2023-09-29") -> "29/9/2023". Parse YYYY-MM-DD, output D/M/YYYY without leading zeros. Actually example "29/9/2023" has no leading zero on day or month. So format day and month as plain integers.

```rust
fn parse_release_date(s: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let parts: Vec<&str> = s.split('-').collect();
    if parts.len() == 3 {
        if let (Some(y), Some(m), Some(d)) = (parts[0].parse::<i64>().ok(), parts[1].parse::<i64>().ok(), parts[2].parse::<i64>().ok()) {
            return Some(format!("{}/{}/{}", d, m, y));
        }
    }
    None
}
```

```rust
impl Title {
    pub fn from_value(r: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<Title> {
        let id = r["id"].as_u64().or_else(|| r["title_id"].as_u64())?;
        let tt = r["title_type"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string();
        let genres = r["genres"].as_array().map(|arr| {
            arr.iter().filter_map(|g| {
                if g.is_string() { g.as_str().map(|s| s.to_string()) }
                else { g["display_name"].as_str().or_else(|| g["name"].as_str()).map(|s| s.to_string()) }
            }).collect()
        });
        Some(Title {
            id,
            name: r["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string(),
            year: r["year"].as_i64(),
            title_type: if tt.is_empty() { None } else { Some(tt) },
            poster: r["poster"].as_str().map(|s| s.to_string()),
            description: r["description"].as_str().map(|s| s.to_string()),
            season_count: r["season_count"].as_i64(),
            genres,
            runtime: r["runtime"].as_i64(),
            episode_count: r["episode_count"].as_i64(),
            release_date: r["release_date"].as_str().map(|s| s.to_string()),
        })
    }
    ...
}
```

```rust
pub fn detail_facts(&self) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut facts = Vec::new();
    if let Some(rt) = self.runtime { if rt > 0 { facts.push(format!("{} dakika", rt)); } }
    match self.episode_count {
        Some(ec) if ec > 0 => facts.push(format!("{} bölüm", ec)),
        _ if self.title_type.as_deref() == Some("movie") => facts.push("Film".to_string()),
        _ => {}
    }
    if let Some(rd) = &self.release_date { if let Some(d) = Self::fmt_release_date(rd) { facts.push(format!("Yayın: {}", d)); } }
    facts
}
```

```rust
fn create_fact_badges(facts: &[String]) -> gtk::Box {
    let box_ = gtk::Box::new(gtk::Orientation::Horizontal, 6);
    box_.set_wrap(true);
    box_.set_halign(gtk::Align::Start);
    for f in facts {
        let b = gtk::Label::new(Some(f));
        b.add_css_class("detail-badge");
        box_.append(&b);
    }
    box_
}
```

Let me implement in episodes_view.rs a function:
```rust
pub fn append_title_meta(info_box: &gtk::Box, t: &Title, name_class: &str) {
    let name = gtk::Label::new(Some(&t.name));
    name.add_css_class(name_class);
    name.set_xalign(0.0);
    name.set_wrap(false);
    name.set_single_line_mode(true);
    name.set_ellipsize(gtk::pango::EllipsizeMode::End);
    name.set_hexpand(true);
    info_box.append(&name);

    if let Some(g) = t.genre_line() {
        let gl = gtk::Label::new(Some(&g));
        gl.add_css_class("dim-label");
        gl.set_xalign(0.0);
        gl.set_wrap(false);
        gl.set_single_line_mode(true);
        gl.set_ellipsize(gtk::pango::EllipsizeMode::End);
        info_box.append(&gl);
    }

    let meta = gtk::Label::new(Some(&t.meta_line()));
    meta.add_css_class("dim-label");
    meta.set_xalign(0.0);
    meta.set_wrap(false);
    meta.set_single_line_mode(true);
    meta.set_ellipsize(gtk::pango::EllipsizeMode::End);
    info_box.append(&meta);
}
```

```rust
/// Kartlarda başlıktan sonra gelen ortak metadata: tür satırı + yıl/tür/sezon satırı.
pub fn append_title_submeta(info_box: &gtk::Box, t: &Title) {
    if let Some(g) = t.genre_line() {
        let gl = gtk::Label::new(Some(&g));
        gl.add_css_class("dim-label");
        gl.set_xalign(0.0);
        gl.set_wrap(false);
        gl.set_single_line_mode(true);
        gl.set_ellipsize(gtk::pango::EllipsizeMode::End);
        info_box.append(&gl);
    }
    let meta = gtk::Label::new(Some(&t.meta_line()));
    meta.add_css_class("dim-label");
    meta.set_xalign(0.0);
    meta.set_wrap(false);
    meta.set_single_line_mode(true);
    meta.set_ellipsize(gtk::pango::EllipsizeMode::End);
    info_box.append(&meta);
}
```

```rust
pub fn enrich_title(&self, t: &Title) -> Title {
    // Arapi cache'den (home_lists) veya search'den taze Title bul
    if let Ok(cats) = self.home_lists() {
        for cat in &cats {
            for it in &cat.items {
                if it.id == t.id {
                    return it.clone();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if let Ok(results) = self.search(&t.name) {
        for r in &results {
            if r.id == t.id {
                return r.clone();
            }
        }
        // isim eşleşmesine göre ilkini döndür (id bulunamazsa)
        if let Some(r) = results.first() {
            if r.name == t.name { return r.clone(); }
        }
    }
    t.clone()
}
```

# Plan: İstek Hızlandırma + README Güncelleme

## 1. Araştırma & Mevcut Durum

**Darboğaz analizi (`src/api.rs` `Client::new`, satır ~329-356):**
- `.pool_max_idle_per_host(1)` → reqwest 0.12 varsayılanı *sınırsız*; uygulama bunu **1**'e çekmiş. Yani aynı ana makineye (özellikle `image.tmdb.org` kapakları) en fazla **1 boşta bağlantı** → ana sayfadaki onlarca kapak görseli tek bağlantıya mahkûm, 4 worker (`covers.rs:133` `max_workers=4`) sıraya giriyor.
- `.pool_idle_timeout(5s)` → keep-alive 5sn sonra kapanıyor; sonraki istek tekrar tam TLS/DNS ödüyor.
- `.connect_timeout(6s)` → ölü host için çok uzun bekleme.
- `hickory-dns` ve `brotli` özellikleri **kapalı** → DNS her seferinde `getaddrinfo` ile blocking, JSON sıkıştırma br ile yapılmıyor.
- `http2` zaten varsayılan açık; sunucu destekliyor (curl `--http2` ile doğrulandı).

**Ölçülen temel (sandbox, curl):** Ana sayfa JSON tek istek ~1–2.5s (soğuk TLS ilk seferde 5.5s). Asıl maliyet *çok sayıda aynı-host isteği* (kapak sürüsü) ve *tekrarlanan TLS/DNS el sıkışması* — bunu kaldırmak asıl kazanç.

## 2. Uygulanacak Değişiklikler

### A. `Cargo.toml` (satır 13)
```toml
reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = ["blocking", "json", "stream", "http2", "brotli", "hickory-dns"] }
```
(`gzip` zaten varsayılan; `brotli` + `hickory-dns` ekleniyor, `http2` açıkça belirtiliyor.)

### B. `src/api.rs` `Client::new` builder
- `.pool_max_idle_per_host(16)` (1 → 16; varsayılan sınırsıza yakın, güvenli)
- `.pool_idle_timeout(Duration::from_secs(60))` (5s → 60s; bağlantı sıcak kalır)
- `.connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(3))` (6s → 3s; hızlı fail)
- `.tcp_keepalive(Duration::from_secs(60))` (sadece sıcak tut)
- `http2` ALPN müzakeresine bırakılır (zorlanmaz; sunucu h2 destekliyor).

### C. `src/covers.rs:133` — kapak worker sayısı
`max_workers = 4` → `max_workers = 12`. HTTP/2 multiplexing tek bağlantıda çoklu akışı ucuz kılar; 4 worker'lık tıkanıklık kalkar. (Görsel daha önce disk-cache'li, asıl kazanç cache-miss/ilk yüklemede.)

### D. `src/api.rs` `enrich_title` — hız regresyonunu önle
Eklediğimiz `search()` ağ çağrısı, favorilerden "İzle"de ek gecikme ekliyor. `search()` fallback'ini **kaldır**; yalnız `home_lists()` (bellek+disk önbelleği 3s) kullan. Ana sayfa zaten yüklenince enrich neredeyse anlık; ağ çağrısı eklenmez → hız korunur.

### E. İsteğe bağlı ölçüm kancaları (rapor için)
`cache_get` ve `get_bytes` içine, `std::env::var("ANIMECIX_BENCH").is_ok()` ise `eprintln!("bench … {:.0?}ms", ...)` ile süre log'lama. Davranışı değiştirmez; kullanıcı terminalden gerçek rakamları görür.

### F. README (`README.md`)
- "Özellikler" altına performans maddesi: "⚡ HTTP/2 multiplexing, bağlantı havuzu ve DNS önbelleği ile hızlı yükleme; kapaklar paralel".
- Yeni "## Performans" alt başlığı: kullanılan teknikler (keep-alive pooling, HTTP/2, brotli, hickory-dns, stale-while-revalidate önbellek) kısa açıklanır.
- Geliştirici notuna `ANIMECIX_BENCH=1 ./animecix` ile zaman ölçümü eklenebilir.

## 3. Test Metodolojı
1. `cargo build` + mevcut birim testler (`cargo test --bin animecix`) yeşil.
2. Sandbox'ta reqwest HTTPS çalışmadığından uygulama içi bench çalıştırılamaz; bunun yerine:
   - curl ile protokol/cold-start kıyaslaması (zaten yapıldı: http1.1 vs http2).
   - Kullanıcı tarafında `ANIMECIX_BENCH=1` ile gerçek uygulama süreleri ölçülür (rapor için kullanıcıdan gelecek).
3. GUI'de manuel doğrulama: ana sayfa açılışı, favorilerden "İzle", kapakların yüklenmesi.

## 4. Yayın
- `bash build_appimage.sh` (sürümü otomatik `1.5.2 → 1.6.0` artırır), AppImage build + GitHub Release.
- `git add` + commit + push + `v1.6.0` tag force-güncelle (remote URL'ye token gömülü).

## 5. Tahmini Süre Azaltımı (yaklaşık)
- **Soğuk ilk yükleme / cache-miss:** tekrarlanan TLS+DNS el sıkışması ortadan kalktığı için bağlantı başına ~0.6s tasarruf × (kapak sürüsü + tekrarlı navigasyonlar). Kapak yığını (≈20–40 görsel) HTTP/2 multiplex + 12 worker ile tahmini **2–4×** daha hızlı.
- **Ana sayfa tek JSON:** steady-state'de ~benzer (~1–2.5s); kazanç sıcak bağlantı reuse ile sonraki gezinmelerde (zaten 3s önbellekli, değişiklik cold-start ve çapraz oturumu iyileştirir).
- **Favorilerden "İzle":** `search()` çağrısı kaldırıldığı için eklenen ağ gecikmesi sıfırlandı (önceki regresyon giderildi).
- Not: sandbox ölçümleri ağ kaynaklı gürültülü; nihai rakam kullanıcının `ANIMECIX_BENCH` çıktısından alınacak.

Let me explain the changes that are UI-visible:
1. Connection pooling keep-alive (pool_idle_timeout 5s→60s, pool_max_idle_per_host 1→16): connections stay warm, so navigating back/forth reuses connection instead of re-handshaking TLS each time. This makes the UI feel snappy on repeat navigation.
2. 12 cover workers (was 4): the home/favorites/marathon cards' poster images load in parallel much faster — the visible "cards pop in" speed.
3. HTTP/2 multiplexing: all those cover requests go over one connection concurrently.
4. hickory-dns: DNS cached, no blocking lookups stalling the UI thread.
5. brotli: homepage JSON smaller → faster to parse/render.
6. enrich_title search() removed: favorites "İzle" opens detail instantly without an extra network call (no spinner delay).

From the websearch excerpts, key points about Anime4K quality:
- Anime4K is "controversial" — it sharpens lines dramatically. Version 0.9 had flaws (banding, line bloating). 1.0RC fixes banding but "doubling GPU consumption", 1.0RC2 optimized.
- It's a "unique upscaler + shader designed for Anime... used to be very destructive, sharpens lines for a unique 'visual quality' look. It works extremely well in some anime and eh in others. Definitely isn't for everyone."
- It does line thinning + line smoothening + sharpening + artifact/texture-denoiser (reduces jpeg-like edges). "filter only active when upscaling."
- Downside: due to line thinning, anime with bad aliasing looks even worse.
- For scale quality ranking: Anime4K is in the "personal preference" middle band. ewa_lanczossharp (our built-in sharp) is also high-quality.
- Importantly: upscale only active when video resolution < display resolution. If watching 1080p on a 1080p screen, upscale does nothing (only the denoise/sharpen filter part may apply). On a 1080p screen watching 720p source, Anime4K 2x would upscale 720→1440 (or to screen). Visible improvement mainly when source is lower-res than screen.

So the honest answer:
- "Gözle görülür" depends on source vs screen resolution. If you watch 1080p content on a 1080p display, upscaling barely changes anything (only subtle sharpening/denoise). If you watch 720p/480p on a 1080p+ screen, Anime4K's line-sharpening/denoising IS visibly noticeable (cleaner lines, less blur/blockiness).
- Anime4K is "controversial": it makes lines sharper/crisper but can look "over-processed" — some love it, some find it artificial. It's not like a magical 4K remaster; it's edge/sharpen enhancement.
- The built-in "Keskinleştir" (ewa_lanczossharp) already gives a clean, natural sharpen with minimal artifacts — for many, that's enough and looks better/more natural than Anime4K.
- Anime4K Lite (iGPU) is the lighter version → less dramatic but still noticeable vs plain bilinear; vs lanczossharp it's a matter of taste.

So: visible improvement = yes, mainly on lower-res sources / upscaling; on native-res it's subtle. Anime4K look is stylized (sharper lines, less jpeg artifacts) — "gözle görülür" ama "doğal mı yoksa yapay mı" zevk meselesi. For an integrated GPU, the Lite variant is the safe choice.

**Kısa cevap: kaynak çözünürlüğüne bağlı — ve Anime4K'ın etkisi "doğal güzelleştirme" değil, "stilize keskinleştirme".**

- **Çözünürlük bağımlı:** Anime4K'ın upscale kısmı yalnızca **kaynak < ekran** olduğunda çalışır. 1080p içeriği 1080p ekranda izliyorsan upscale neredeyse hiçbir şey değiştirmez (sadece hafif denoise/sharpen). 720p/480p bir kaynağı 1080p+ ekranda izliyorsan o zaman **çizgiler belirgin şekilde daha keskin, bloklanma/aliasing azalmış** görünür — bu gerçekten "gözle görülür".
- **Anime4K "controversial":** Literatürde açıkça "çizgileri aşırı keskinleştirir, kendine has bir görünümü var; bazı animede çok iyi, bazısında eh işte; herkese göre değil" deniyor. Yani artış **var** ama "yapay mı doğal mı" tamamen zevk meselesi. 0.9 sürümünde çizgi şişmesi/banlama sorunları vardı; 1.0RC2'de düzeltilmiş.
- **Bizim "Keskinleştir" (ewa_lanczossharp) zaten yüksek kaliteli:** Birçok kullanıcı için doğal ve temiz duruyor; Anime4K'a göre daha az artefaktlı. Yani "Keskinleştir" varsayılanı çoğu durumda yeterli ve daha doğal.
- **Lite (iGPU) varyantı:** en hafif profil → etkisi tam Anime4K kadar dramatik değil, ama düz bilinear'a göre yine belirgin; `lanczossharp` ile aynı ligde, "daha animevi çizgi" katıyor.

## Özet
- 1080p ekranda 1080p izliyorsan: **fark minimal** (Anime4K da Keskinleştir de hafif).
- Düşük çözünürlüklü kaynak izliyorsan: **Anime4K Lite gözle görülür** (daha temiz çizgiler), ama görünüm "stilize" — beğenirsin ya da görmezsin.

```
fn resolve_upscale_shader() -> Option<String> {
    let mut candidates = Vec::new();
    if let Ok(ad) = std::env::var("APPDIR") { if !ad.is_empty() {
        candidates.push(std::path::Path::new(&ad).join("usr/share/animecix/assets/upscale/Anime4K_Upscale_DTD_x2.glsl"));
    }}
    if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() { if let Some(parent) = exe.parent() {
        candidates.push(parent.join("usr/share/animecix/assets/upscale/Anime4K_Upscale_DTD_x2.glsl"));
        candidates.push(parent.join("assets/upscale/Anime4K_Upscale_DTD_x2.glsl"));
    }}
    candidates.into_iter().find(|p| p.exists()).map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
}
```

```
/// MPV upscale arg'larını döndürür. shader_path yalnızca "anime4k" modunda kullanılır.
pub(crate) fn upscale_mpv_args(upscale: &str, shader_path: Option<&str>) -> Vec<String> {
    match upscale {
        "sharp" => vec![
            "--scale=ewa_lanczossharp".into(),
            "--cscale=ewa_lanczossharp".into(),
            "--dsharpen=1".into(),
        ],
        "anime4k" => match shader_path {
            Some(p) => vec![format!("--glsl-shaders={p}")],
            None => Vec::new(),
        },
        _ => Vec::new(),
    }
}
```

```
/// Çalışma anında Anime4K shader dosyasının yolunu bulur (AppImage'da APPDIR,
/// geliştirme ortamında exe'nin yakınları). Bulunamazsa None -> özellik pas geçilir.
fn resolve_upscale_shader() -> Option<String> {
    let mut candidates: Vec<std::path::PathBuf> = Vec::new();
    if let Ok(ad) = std::env::var("APPDIR") {
        if !ad.is_empty() {
            candidates.push(std::path::Path::new(&ad).join("usr/share/animecix/assets/upscale/Anime4K_Upscale_DTD_x2.glsl"));
        }
    }
    if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() {
        if let Some(parent) = exe.parent() {
            candidates.push(parent.join("usr/share/animecix/assets/upscale/Anime4K_Upscale_DTD_x2.glsl"));
            candidates.push(parent.join("assets/upscale/Anime4K_Upscale_DTD_x2.glsl"));
            candidates.push(parent.join("../../assets/upscale/Anime4K_Upscale_DTD_x2.glsl"));
        }
    }
    candidates.into_iter().find(|p| p.exists()).map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
}

impl App {
```

```
fn upscale_mpv_args_modes() {
    assert!(super::upscale_mpv_args("off", None).is_empty());
    assert!(super::upscale_mpv_args("kapali", None).is_empty());
    let sharp = super::upscale_mpv_args("sharp", None);

}
```

```
fn resolve_upscale_shader(name: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let mut candidates: Vec<std::path::PathBuf> = Vec::new();
    if let Ok(ad) = std::env::var("APPDIR") {
        if !ad.is_empty() {
            candidates.push(std::path::Path::new(&ad).join("usr/share/animecix/assets/upscale").join(name));
        }
    }
    if let Ok(exe) = std::env::current_exe() {
        if let Some(parent) = exe.parent() {
            candidates.push(parent.join("usr/share/animecix/assets/upscale").join(name));
            candidates.push(parent.join("assets/upscale").join(name));
            candidates.push(parent.join("../../assets/upscale").join(name));
        }
    }
    candidates.into_iter().find(|p| p.exists()).map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
}
```

```
let mut playing = false;
```

```
        let mut g = mpv_child.lock().unwrap();
        match g.as_mut().unwrap().try_wait() { Ok(Some(_))=>true, Ok(None)=>false, Err(_)=>true }

    if elapsed>25 -> break;

}
```

            }
        }
    }
    t.clone()
}

```rust
// tests/next_episode.rs
use std::sync::mpsc;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::process::{Child, Command};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

#[test]
fn supervisor_worker_no_deadlock_on_next() {
    // Dummy child that stays alive until killed (like mpv playing a video)
    let child = Command::new("sleep").arg("30").spawn().expect("spawn sleep");
    let mpv_child = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Some(child)));
    let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel::<u64>(); // next episode number

    // Supervisor thread: polls try_wait, does NOT block-wait holding lock
    let mpv_child_sup = mpv_child.clone();
    let supervisor = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let start = Instant::now();
        let mut playing = true;
        loop {
            let exited = {
                let mut g = mpv_child_sup.lock().unwrap();
                match g.as_mut().unwrap().try_wait() {
                    Ok(Some(_)) => true,
                    Ok(None) => false,
                    Err(_) => true,
                }
            };
            if exited { break; }
            if start.elapsed() > Duration::from_secs(25) && !playing { break; }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));
        }
        playing
    });

    // Worker thread: after a short delay, kills the child and sends next episode
    let mpv_child_w = mpv_child.clone();
    let tx_w = tx.clone();
    let worker = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200));
        // simulate 'n' pressed
        if let Some(c) = mpv_child_w.lock().unwrap().as_mut() {
            let _ = c.kill();
        }
        let _ = tx_w.send(2u64);
    });

    // The channel must receive the next episode quickly (deadlock would hang here)
    let received = rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5)).expect("no deadlock: next episode not received");
    assert_eq!(received, 2);
    let played = supervisor.join().unwrap();
    assert!(played);
    worker.join().unwrap();
}
```

This test directly reproduces the deadlock scenario: the supervisor holds the shared child and the worker must kill it. Plan for test:
```rust
#[test]
fn dispatch_next_episode_invokes_play() {
    // GLib main loop init (headless ok for main context, no GTK widgets needed)
    let ctx = glib::MainContext::default();
    let loop_ = glib::MainLoop::new(Some(&ctx), false);

    let play_called = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
    let play_called_c = play_called.clone();
    let alive = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(true));
    let alive_c = alive.clone();

    let (next_tx, next_rx) = mpsc::channel::<u64>();
    let next_rx = Arc::new(Mutex::new(next_rx));
    let next_tx_w = next_tx.clone();

    // Mimic the GTK callback
    let play_called_t = play_called_c.clone();
    glib::timeout_add_local(150ms, move || {
        let msg = { next_rx.lock().unwrap().try_recv().ok() };
        if let Some(ep) = msg { play_called_t.fetch_add(1, SeqCst); }
        if alive_c.load(SeqCst) { Continue } else { Break }
    });

    // Background "worker" sends next episode, then "supervisor" sets alive false
    let loop2 = loop_.clone();
    thread::spawn(move || {
        thread::sleep(200ms);
        let _ = next_tx_w.send(2);
        thread::sleep(100ms);
        alive.store(false, SeqCst);
        thread::sleep(50ms);
        loop2.quit();
    });

    loop_.run();
    assert!(play_called.load(SeqCst) >= 1, "play çağrılmadı");
}
```

```rust
fn supervisor_exit_decision(exited: bool, success: bool, playing: bool, next_triggered: bool) -> (bool, bool) {

}
```

```
                        kill all others (j != current winner idx);

                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
```

- `git checkout HEAD -- Cargo.toml src/app.rs src/api.rs` → v2.7.2 baseline'ına döner. Bu otomatik olarak şunları geri alır:
  - Paralel race manager (`children`/`active_sock`/`winner_idx`) → tek `mpv_child` + sıralı supervisor.
  - OSD `show_text` değişikliği → orijinal toast.
  - api.rs passthrough/ordering eklemelerim (temiz "eski sistem" için).
  - `Cargo.toml` 3.1.3 → 2.7.2.
- `build_appimage.sh` değişikliği (patch bump) **korunur** → release 2.7.2 → **2.7.3**.

### 2. sibnet Referer düzeltmesini yeniden ekle (ep7 için kritik)
- `src/app.rs` supervisor'ında mpv `Command` argümanlarına ekle (HEAD süpervizörü `Command::new("mpv")` satırı civarında):
  ```rust
  if url.contains("sibnet") {
      cmd.arg("--http-header-fields=Referer: https://video.sibnet.ru/");
  }
  ```
  Bu, sibnet CDN'in 403 vermesini engeller (mpv Referer göndermediği için ep7 açılmıyordu).

### 3. "bölüm açılıyor" toast'unu süresiz yap
- `src/app.rs` satır ~1647'deki `"▶ {media_title} açılıyor…"` toast: `set_timeout(3)` → `set_timeout(0)` (sticky).
- Toast'ı bir field'da (`opening_toast`) tut ve **bölüm gerçekten açılınca** (supervisor başarı path'inde `set_loading(false)` çağrılan yerde) dismiss et — böylece "bölüm açılana kadar gösterilir" ve birikmez.

### 4. Kapak fotoğrafı disk cache'i
- `src/api.rs` `get_bytes` içinde, network fetch'ten sonra disk'e yaz:
  ```rust
  if let Some(ref data) = out {
      let _ = std::fs::write(&disk_path, data);
  }
  return out;
  ```
  (`covers/` dizini `Client::new`'da zaten oluşturuluyor; `img_cache_path` doğru path'i veriyor.)

### 5. Doğrulama & release
- `cargo build` + `cargo test` (HEAD'deki `decide_retry` unit testleri + `tests/next_episode.rs` yeşil kalmalı).
- `bash build_appimage.sh` → **v2.7.3** AppImage üret + commit/tag/push (mevcut PAT ile).

New decide_retry:
```rust
    fn decide_retry(
        exited: bool,
        success: bool,
        playing: bool,
    ) -> (bool, bool) {
        if !exited {
            return (false, playing);
        }
        if playing && !success {
            return (true, false);
        }
        (false, playing)
    }
```

```
                }
```

New handler:

```
        // Worker/supervisor iş parçacıklarından ana iş parçacığına toast bildirimi (GObject'lar Send değil)
        let (toast_tx, toast_rx) = std::sync::mpsc::channel::<String>();
        const DISMISS_OPENING: &str = "__animecix_dismiss_opening__";
        {
            let toast_rx = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(toast_rx));
            let alive_toast = alive.clone();
            let toast_h = toast.clone();
            let opening_toast_h = self.opening_toast.clone();
            glib::timeout_add_local(std::time::Duration::from_millis(200), move || {
                let rx = toast_rx.lock().unwrap();
                let mut msg: Option<String> = None;
                loop {
                    match rx.try_recv() {
                        Ok(m) => msg = Some(m),
                        Err(std::sync::mpsc::TryRecvError::Empty) => break,
                        Err(std::sync::mpsc::TryRecvError::Disconnected) => break,
                    }
                }
                drop(rx);
                if let Some(m) = msg {
                    if m == DISMISS_OPENING {
                        if let Some(t) = opening_toast_h.borrow_mut().take() {
                            t.dismiss();
                        }
                    } else {
                        let tt = adw::Toast::new(&m);
                        tt.set_timeout(3);
                        toast_h.add_toast(tt);
                    }
                }
                if !alive_toast.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed) {
                    glib::ControlFlow::Break
                } else {
                    glib::ControlFlow::Continue
                }
            });
        }
```

```
fn sibnet_resolve(&self, url: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    // extract mp4 path from embed page as before -> mp4_url

    let mp4_url = ...; // https://video.sibnet.ru/v/<hash>/<id>.mp4
    let resp = self.http.get(&mp4_url)

        .header("Accept", "*/*")

        .send().map_err(...)?;

}
```

- **Root cause of slow fallback**: once a source's IPC socket appears, supervisor sets `playing=true` and breaks (assumes success). If the source actually opened but is broken/stuck (mpv idle, no playback), it never falls back → user waits forever. The 25s "never opened" timeout only covers sources that never open.

  2. In supervisor loop, after `playing=true`, add health check: after ~10s grace, if `query_mpv_prop(&sock_path_c,"core-idle")`≥1.0 AND `query_mpv_prop(&sock_path_c,"playback-time")`<1.0 → kill mpv, set `playing=false`, `break` inner loop so it retries next candidate (with a toast "Kaynak açıldı ama oynatamadı, diğer kaynağa geçiliyor…"). Natural EOF avoided because pos≈duration (>1) there.

Edit 1 — api.rs resolve_mal_id: better cleaning + fallback candidates.
```rust
pub fn resolve_mal_id(&self, anime_name: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    let mut base = anime_name
        .replace("(TV)", " ")
        .replace("Türkçe", " ")
        .replace("Dublaj", " ")
        .replace("Altyazılı", " ")
        .replace("Çizgi Film", " ");
    // parantez içini at
    if let Some(p) = base.find('(') { if let Some(q) = base.find(')') { if q>p { base.replace_range(p..=q, " "); } } }
    // sezon tokenlarını at: "2. Sezon","Sezon 2","Season 2","2nci Sezon" vb + romen
    let tokens: Vec<&str> = base.split_whitespace()
        .filter(|t| {
            let low = t.to_lowercase();
            !(low.contains("sezon") || low.contains("season") || low.contains("bölüm")
              || low.trim_end_matches('.').chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit())
              || matches!(low.trim_end_matches('.'), "i"|"ii"|"iii"|"iv"|"v"))
        })
        .collect();
    let cleaned = tokens.join(" ").trim().to_string();
    let mut cands: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    if !cleaned.is_empty() { cands.push(cleaned.clone()); }
    // fallback: ilk iki kelime
    let words: Vec<&str> = cleaned.split_whitespace().collect();
    if words.len() > 2 {
        let short = words[..2].join(" ");
        if !cands.contains(&short) { cands.push(short); }
    }
    for cand in &cands {
        let key = format!("mal_id:{cand}");
        if let Ok(d) = self.cache_get(&key, 30*86400, |http| { ...query cand... }) {
            if let Some(id) = d["data"]["Media"]["idMal"].as_u64() { return Some(id); }
        }
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(300)); // anilist rate limit nazikçe
    }
    None
}
```
Careful: closure borrows cand — fine inside loop.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Kullanım: import_link.sh "<vmess://|vless://|trojan:// ...>"
set -uo pipefail
LINK="$1"
DIR="$HOME/.local/share/xray"
BIN="$DIR/xray"
CONF="$DIR/config.json"
LOG="$DIR/xray.log"

python3 - "$LINK" "$CONF.pin" <<'PYEOF'
... parse per docs-flat format ...
PYEOF

start_and_test() {
  killall xray 2>/dev/null
  sleep 0.5
  "$BIN" run -c "$CONF" > "$LOG" 2>&1 &
  sleep 1.5
  CODE=$(curl -s --max-time 10 -x socks5h://127.0.0.1:10808 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://www.gstatic.com/generate_204)
  [ "$CODE" = "204" ]
}

# 1) düz dene
cp "$CONF.pin" "$CONF"
if start_and_test; then OK=1; fi

# 2) olmazsa sertifika pinle
if [ "${OK:-0}" != "1" ]; then
  python3 - "$CONF" <<'PY2'
  # sunucudan leaf parmak izini çek, pinnedPeerCertSha256 ekle
  PY2
  start_and_test && OK=1
fi
...
```

### ASSISTANT:
The user asks: "peki bunun herhangi bi yan etkisi olur mu?" — "Would this have any side effects?"

They're asking about the "Hafif Mod" (light mode) plan — GSK_RENDERER=cairo + MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 side effects.

I'm in plan mode, read-only. I should give an honest, well-researched answer about potential side effects. Let me think through this carefully:

**GSK_RENDERER=cairo side effects:**

1. **Rendering performance/animation smoothness:**
   - Cairo renders on CPU; GL/Vulkan render on GPU
   - On machines WITH a real GPU: scrolling long lists, window resize animations, transitions may be less fluid. GTK4's cairo renderer is the "legacy" fallback — it's correct but slower for complex UIs with many textures/effects
   - On machines WITHOUT proper GPU drivers (VMs, old laptops): cairo can actually be FASTER/more stable than software-Vulkan (lavapipe), because it avoids LLVM JIT overhead
   - Our app's UI: lists, cards, images, toasts — not shader-heavy. Real-world difference likely minimal, but heavy fast-scrolling through cover grids is the most noticeable candidate

2. **Visual differences:**
   - Minor anti-aliasing/sharpness differences in some corners/shadows possible
   - libadwaita shadows/gradients render slightly differently in cairo vs gl — subtle

3. **Screenshot/video capture:** no impact really.

4. **Fractional scaling / HiDPI:** cairo handles it fine; historically some scaling artifacts were better/worse across renderers at various GTK versions. Generally OK.

5. **Memory:** we measured -51 MB. Also LESS VRAM usage.

6. **Video playback:** mpv is a SEPARATE process with its own GPU output (vo=gpu next etc.) — completely unaffected by GSK_RENDERER. Only the GTK app window rendering changes.

7. **Crash risk:** cairo renderer is the oldest, most battle-tested path — arguably LOWER crash risk than ngl/vulkan paths, especially on weird drivers.

**MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 side effects:**
- Limits glibc malloc arenas → less memory bloat from multi-threaded allocations
- Potential downside: more lock contention between threads allocating simultaneously → theoretically slight performance cost under high parallel allocation pressure (our 12 cover-download workers!). In practice for our workload: negligible; downloads are network-bound not malloc-bound.
- Very safe, widely used server-side tuning knob.

**Image cache cap (150 entries) side effects:**
- If user scrolls back to previously seen covers after viewing >150 newer ones, those images re-load from DISK cache instead of RAM → imperceptible delay (~ms), no network refetch (disk TTL 7 days)
- No visual breakage

**Toggle default ON concern:**
- Users with strong GPUs who want max fluidity must find the toggle. Mitigation: settings subtitle explains.
- Future GTK versions: if cairo path gets deprecated... unlikely soon (it's the fallback).

Also worth noting how env vars behave: setting via std::env::set_var before gtk init affects only our process and children (mpv inherits env! GSK_RENDERER would leak into mpv — harmless since mpv isn't gtk4; MALLOC_ARENA_MAX inherited by mpv — actually fine/harmless, maybe even good).

Wait, one REAL consideration: children inherit env — `--http-proxy` unaffected. mpv uses its own VO (gpu) independent of GSK. So no impact on video quality/performance.

Another edge: Wayland vs X11 — cairo works on both. Fractional scale protocols fine.

So honest summary: main tradeoff = animation/scroll fluidity on GPU-capable machines; everything else neutral or positive. Toggle exists exactly for that. Recommend default ON still (user's priority = RAM), easy to flip.

Keep response concise, structured, Turkish. End asking if plan approved (they haven't answered the default-ON question yet).
